parameters.jsCode: const x=$json; if(!x.requestId||!x.conversationId||!x.intent||!x.tool||!x.toolResultId||typeof x.message!=='string') throw new Error('Invalid grounded-answer input'); if(/(?:^|\D)\d+(?:\.\d+)?/.test(x.message) && !JSON.stringify(x.toolResult??{}).match(/\d/)) throw new Error('Numeric answer lacks numeric tool evidence'); return [{json:{version:'1.0',requestId:x.requestId,conversationId:x.conversationId,kind:'answer',message:x.message,citationsToToolResults:[x.toolResultId],meta:{intent:x.intent,tool:x.tool}}}];
